verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OpenAPI spec design and linting (inso lint spec), after-response scripting, and collection test runs, but nothing documents validating live responses against the API contract to detect drift. Spec linting checks the spec itself, and scripting is only a building block a user could use to construct such checks. The Konnect/MCP mention covers validating requests through a different product, not response-vs-contract checks in Insomnia.
